brand_identity.name: OTG Sneaker Cleaning
brand_identity.description: Premium sneaker cleaning and restoration brand. High-end sneaker boutique meets streetwear and professional detailing studio.
brand_identity.core_aesthetic: Extremely clean, modern, bold, youthful, and expensive. Monochromatic palette.
brand_identity.tagline: Where Dirty Sneakers Get a Second Chance.
rules: Do NOT introduce bright colors, gradients in unrelated colors, blue, red, green, orange, purple, or generic corporate colors.
Overall visual direction: BLACK + CHARCOAL + WHITE + PREMIUM SNEAKER CULTURE.
Avoid: generic blue business websites, excessive rounded corners, huge text blocks, generic Bootstrap layouts.

backgrounds.notes: Use primary backgrounds for main sections and secondary backgrounds for cards or distinct sections.

text.notes: Strong contrast between black backgrounds and white typography.

borders_and_accents.notes: Use thin white/transparent borders for cards, dividers, and transparent buttons.

fonts.headings: Anton, Bebas Neue, Oswald, or Space Grotesk Bold
fonts.notes: Headings must be strictly used for large, condensed editorial typography.

sizing.hero_headline: text-6xl sm:text-7xl lg:text-[10vw] leading-[0.85] tracking-tighter uppercase

treatment.uppercase: Selective uppercase on all subheadings, eyebrows, and CTA buttons.
treatment.highlight: Specific words like 'SECOND CHANCE.' treated with charcoal or outlined text.

libraries: framer-motion (for scroll reveals, micro-interactions, layout transitions)

effects.hero: GSAP/Framer Motion scroll reveals. Masked line-by-line hero headline reveal.
effects.parallax: Apply parallax scrolling to large sneaker images and floating typographic elements.
effects.hover: Image zoom inside clipped frames, invert colors on primary buttons, thin borders glow slightly.
effects.marquee: One slow, continuous editorial marquee. Do not make it too fast.

buttons.primary: bg-white text-black font-bold uppercase tracking-widest px-8 py-4 hover:bg-[#111] hover:text-white transition-colors duration-300 border border-white
buttons.secondary: bg-transparent text-white border border-white/20 font-bold uppercase tracking-widest px-8 py-4 hover:bg-white hover:text-black transition-colors duration-300

cards.textures: Subtle grain/noise texture overlay via CSS on top of dark cards for depth.

navigation.style: Fixed sticky navbar, solid background or heavy glassmorphism with high opacity (bg-[#080808]/90 backdrop-blur-xl). Never fully transparent.
navigation.scroll_state: Darkens on scroll, height compresses slightly.
navigation.mobile: Hamburger menu opening to a full-screen dark overlay menu.

testing_and_accessibility.data_testid: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case.

instructions_to_main_agent: You are using React with .js files, NOT .tsx. Provide the implementation in .js.
Implement Lenis for smooth momentum scrolling across the entire application.
Use Framer Motion to build the specific kinetic hero reveal and parallax effects.
Do NOT center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; } is FORBIDDEN).
Ensure extreme visual hierarchy. Typography should do 80% of the heavy lifting. Avoid generic blocks.
The forms MUST use customized shadcn components mapped to our monochrome color scheme (no default Vercel white/blue rings).
DO NOT USE INTER, ROBOTO, or LATO for the main Headings. You must use Anton, Bebas Neue, Oswald, or Space Grotesk Bold.
Inject a site configuration object/file to manage constants (social links, email, form endpoints, texts).
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) where necessary, but NO transparent header over content
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g. transition: all). Add transitions to specific properties to avoid breaking Framer motion.
Always use modern button styles, specifically matching the sharp, thin-border styling outlined in the design guidelines.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc. for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures and noise overlays separate good from extraordinary.
Never use placeholder URLs (like via.placeholder.com). Use the curated image_urls provided.
